short_description:
Formula:
Aqua, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Panthenol, Hydroxyacetophenone, 1,2-Hexanediol, Trehalose, Betaine, Ectoin, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Triethanolamine, Jojoba Wax Peg-120 Esters, Xanthan Gum, Hydroxyethylcellulose, 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid.
Efficacy:
Moisturizes and nourishes the skin. It replenishes water and locks in moisture, repairs and reduces inflammation. Panthenol is known as “the moisturizer of the skin” and a top tier ingredient in skin repair. Panthenol has strong moisturizing, repairing and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help relieve irritation and improve skin barrier function and regulate skin pH value.
